legal.cancel_weather: 100% refund or reschedule at operator's discretion
legal.cancel_noshow: No refund (no contact on the day)
legal.ins_limit: Up to KRW 300,000,000 per claim · Deductible KRW 3,000,000
legal.ins_scope: Covers third-party liability incidents during tour operations, including leisure and sports activities.
legal.ins_condition: Applicable only on guided tours. Accidents during unsupervised free riding are excluded.
legal.ins_personal: This policy covers operator liability only, not participant medical costs. Participants are strongly advised to purchase their own travel insurance.
legal.ins_exclusion: Self-inflicted accidents, riding under the influence, traffic violations, natural disasters, theft, and infectious diseases are excluded.
legal.safety_1: Wearing a helmet is mandatory. Riding without one is not permitted.
legal.safety_2: Cycling under the influence is illegal and will result in immediate exclusion from the tour.
legal.safety_3: Traffic signals and cycling path rules must be followed at all times.
legal.safety_4: Inspect your bike upon receipt and report any issues before departure.
legal.safety_5: Ride at reduced speed at night or in adverse weather conditions.
legal.safety_6: Bikes are fitted with GPS trackers and anti-theft alarms.
legal.health_1: If you have heart conditions, hypertension, or other conditions limiting strenuous activity, consult a doctor before participating.
legal.health_2: Pregnant women are not permitted to participate for safety reasons.
legal.health_3: Get adequate sleep and stay hydrated the night before your tour.
legal.health_4: If your health deteriorates mid-tour, notify staff immediately.
legal.other_1: This is an outdoor activity. Some routes may be adjusted due to weather.
legal.other_3: Meeting point: Dangsan Station Exit 4. Please arrive 10 minutes before departure.
legal.other_4: Dashcam footage is for personal use only and will not be used for marketing without consent.
legal.other_5: Repair costs may be charged for damage caused by intentional misuse or gross negligence.
legal.other_6: Children under 12 must be accompanied by a guardian (19 or older).

drinking.title: No Riding Under the Influence
drinking.body1: Anyone showing signs of intoxication will be immediately denied boarding — no refund will be issued.
drinking.body2: Bicycles are classified as vehicles under the Road Traffic Act. Cycling under the influence is a criminal offense (fine or imprisonment).
drinking.body3: For the safety of others and yourself, please confirm you are sober before joining the tour.

about.hero_title:
The deeper you pedal,
the more beautiful Korea becomes
about.hero_subtitle: HealingBikeTour offers expert-guided bike tours and premium bike rental services. Ride verified routes on well-maintained bikes and safely experience Korea's beauty.
about.story_p1: HealingBikeTour was founded by passionate cyclists who spent years riding Korea's mountains, rivers, coasts and cities, and wanted to share that beauty with more people.
about.story_p2: Expert-guided tours or premium bike rentals for independent riders — two ways to experience the beauty of the Han River and Korea's cycling trails.
about.story_p3: From first-timers to experienced riders, choose the style that fits your pace.

bikes.hero_subtitle:
Choose from road, MTB, mini-road or e-bike.
Every bike includes dashcam + tour footage as standard.
bikes.cta_video: Dashcam + tour footage included on every bike
bikes.tcr6500_desc: Giant's classic aluminum road bike. Shimano Tiagra drivetrain and 700c wheels handle everything from city riding to mid-distance routes with ease.
bikes.tcr6500_for: Road beginners · City riding · Han River routes
bikes.yukon_desc: A performance road bike with a carbon frame for maximum weight savings. Shimano 105 groupset delivers precise shifting and lively response for a more dynamic ride.
bikes.cayin_tagline: Carbon comfort at a great value
bikes.cayin_desc: Cello's carbon road bike. Shimano Tiagra's reliable shifting combined with carbon's smooth ride character means you can stay comfortable over long distances.
bikes.bianchi1885_tagline: A classic from a legendary Italian brand
bikes.bianchi1885_desc: An aluminum road bike from Bianchi, founded in Italy in 1885. Clean lines and Shimano Tiagra make for a ride that satisfies both style and performance.
bikes.callas_desc: Cello's 27.5-inch aluminum MTB. Shimano XT+SLX drivetrain and wide tires keep you stable and controlled on gravel or rough terrain.
bikes.principia_desc: Principia's 26-inch aluminum MTB. Top-tier Shimano XT+SLX shifting handles climbs and descents with precision.
bikes.zaskar_tagline: All-rounder that awakens your trail instincts
bikes.zaskar_desc: GT's signature MTB line. Shimano Alivio drivetrain and a sturdy aluminum frame make this a true all-rounder from trail to city.
bikes.aspen_desc: Jaeger's aluminum MTB with Shimano XT for accurate, snappy shifting. Low fatigue even on long rides.
bikes.aspen_limited_desc: A limited edition fitted with Italian Campagnolo Athena derailleurs. Enjoy a uniquely smooth shift feel with a touch of retro charm.
bikes.aspen_limited_for: Premium component enthusiasts · Special riding experiences
bikes.meridan_tagline: Carbon mini-road, tailored for smaller riders
bikes.meridan_desc: Cello's 27.5-inch carbon mini-road bike. Optimised sizing for smaller frames plus Shimano Sora for a light, fun ride.
bikes.tx8_pro_desc: Motobello folding e-bike. Aluminum folding frame stores easily. Shimano 7-speed and 250W hub motor tackle hills effortlessly, up to 60km per charge.
bikes.tx8_pro_for: Urban commuting · Folding preference · Light Han River rides
bikes.tx8_pro3_tagline: Fat-tire folding, steady on any surface
bikes.tx8_pro3_desc: Fat-tire version of the TX8 series. 20x4.0-inch wide tires provide stable traction on gravel, unpaved paths, and wet surfaces.
bikes.tx8_pro3_for: Unpaved sections · Stability seekers · Folding e-bike
bikes.viaggio_v6_desc: AUTech premium e-bike. 20Ah lithium-ion battery with BMS protection covers up to 160km on a full charge. Front and seat suspension, colour LCD display, and LED headlight included.
bikes.viaggio_v6_for: Riders concerned about stamina · Seniors · Long-distance peace of mind
